notes.title: Update March 6, 2025. Version 1.6.7.
notes.notes: An 80's style synthwave soundtrack has been added to the game for a more immersive experience.

notes.title: Update January 5, 2025. version 1.6.6b
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with one missing achievement and one unopened episode in the gallery. Fixed some bugs in Chinese translation (about 80 changes in total).

notes.title: 2024/11/16 update
notes.notes: Added a full translation of all current chapters into Simplified Chinese. I hope Chinese comrades will enjoy my game.

notes.title: The game is now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921414/01e261e01e420b5532fadf606fdaed89c9f0280d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921414/ba2b238386e6467d10026cc65d8b24eaf9ebda64.jpg[/img][/url]

Today the game has been released in Early Access on Steam. In celebration of the game's release until the 20th of November there is a 20% discount.
So far the game is available in two languages - English and Russian.
Translations to other languages are planned to be added a little later. Among those planned for the near future are French and Simplified Chinese.
I really hope that you will like the game.
Due to unresolved problems with licences for instrumental versions of Soviet songs, the music has been temporarily removed from the game. The soundtrack to the game will be added later, when the problems with copyright holders will be solved. In the meantime... turn on your favourite 80's music playlist in your player and enjoy!

notes.title: New build 1.6.6b
notes.notes:
A new build of the 1.6.6b demo was released today. French translation has been added, as well as hints for passing the test on PC.
If you failed the test the first time, select the “Time was short (One more try)” option in the dialog and you will be able to take the test again and with hints.
All mini-games can be skipped. The “Skip mini-game” button will appear either after three unsuccessful attempts or after a small amount of time (5-10 seconds) has elapsed.
